description: ADO-CURSOR, second connection writes: connection A holds a server keyset, static, dynamic (requested) and a client static read-only recordset of K, all read once; connection B updates L of ID 2, inserts a row and deletes ID 3 (B's own read follows); A's four recordsets are re-read at once, after 8 s, and after Requery. The same sequence is repeated with ID 4. Asks which cursor kinds see another connection's changes and whether time matters.
